verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is a local video-production app that orchestrates Claude Code or Codex. A tool like this could plausibly publish an official MCP server for outside agents to drive it, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an MCP server, endpoint or 'mcp serve' mode. The 'adding another AI' extension point is about plugging in AI backends that ReelMimic itself uses, not about exposing ReelMimic to other agents, so it earns no credit here.
